title: BackOps, which makes automation tools for supply chain operations, raised a $26M Series A led by Theory Ventures (Natalie Breymeyer/Axios)
summary: Natalie Breymeyer / Axios: BackOps, which makes automation tools for supply chain operations, raised a $26M Series A led by Theory Ventures — BackOps, which makes automation tools for supply chain operations, raised a $26 million Series A round, CEO Sean McCarthy tells Axios exclusively.
